messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not use Flonase nasal spray:
- if you are allergic to fluticasone or to any of the other ingredients
- to treat asthma
- if you have had an injury to your nose, or surgery on your nose, that is not fully healed.
To make sure Flonase is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
- sores or ulcers inside your nose;
- injury of or surgery on your nose;
- glaucoma or cataracts;
- liver disease;
- diabetes;
- a weak immune system; or
- any type of infection (bacterial, fungal, viral, or parasitic).
If you use Flonase without a prescription and you have any medical conditions, ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe for you.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Triplet: ["Flonase Nasal Spray", "not indicated for", "asthma"]

The relation 'not indicated for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is not intended or approved for the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
B. 'not a': The subject drug is not classified as or does not belong to the category specified by the object entity.
C. 'has off label use': The subject drug is used for purposes not specifically approved or listed in the official medication guide, as specified by the object entity.
D. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
